definitions: To spend time idly or unproductively.
To behave in a silly or playful way.
To interfere with something or someone in a way that causes problems or annoyance.
To be unfaithful in a romantic relationship.
examples: They just messed around all afternoon.
Stop messing around and get to work.
Someone messed around with the settings.
He's been messing around with other people.
pastTenses: messed around (past simple), messed around (past perfect)
